notes.title: Balance hotfix: Lotara Sarrin
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/14fd508b214e60b8b61916164ddb79f3f932f6d7.jpg[/img]
[i]"This is New Kershal all over again. Disengage!"[/i]
– Lotara Sarrin

Lotara returned to the battlefields of the Horus Heresy in force, and her initial performance sounded all of the alarms. Even though we have seen in the past how new cards and Warlords have achieved higher-than-average win rates while the meta reacts and players learn how to counter the new challengers, Lotara became a force to be reckoned with. This created a frustrating ladder to take part in, and a repetitive and tiresome competitive environment.

For this reason, today we are releasing an emergency balance hotfix addressing the situation and tweaking the main offenders of Lotara's ranked dominance:

[b]IMPERIAL ARMY[/b]
● [b]Lotara Sarrin[/b]: Changed Savage ability to [i]'Give Flank to adjacent troops'[/i] (it no longer buffs adjacent troops)

[b]MECHANICUM[/b]
● [b]Glaividian Ursarax[/b]: Increased ability cost from 0 to 1 and changed ability to [i]'(1) Stun a random enemy troop'[/i] (instead of a random enemy).

These changes are now live in the game. We will continue to monitor the situation, as well as monitor the rest of the meta in preparation for the next balance update, currently scheduled for the first full week of the next competitive season.

notes.title: The Nights Lords are ready to haunt the battlefield
notes.content:
[i]"Night falls. The hunt begins."[/i]
– Konrad Curze

[h1]AVE DOMINUS NOX[/h1]
At the end of light, the shadows grow only larger. The macabre hosts of Konrad Curze are ready to bring the night to the battlefields of the Horus Heresy! The Hidden Dagger expansion for Warhammer Horus Heresy: Legions begins with the release of the new Night Lords collection, featuring fresh new artwork and game mechanics perfect for the murderous VIII Legion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/37743070b31f12fbd7ef17b381081be96919e5e8.jpg[/img]

[h1]NIGHT LORDS WARLORDS[/h1]
Many Night Lords warriors engulfed the Galaxy in terror, but among them, three of their mightiest heroes were chosen to lead the Legion into battle:
[list]
[*][b]Kheron Ophion[/b]: Possessing a sense of honour rare among his Legion, his shield is a constant reminder of his greatest failure.
[*][b]Sevatar[/b]: Arrogant, ruthless and utterly infamous, Sevatar is a living avatar of the VIII Legion’s dark purpose.
[*][b]Konrad Curze[/b]: The feared Primarch of the Night Lords, who brought judgment rather than deliverance to the worlds he claimed.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f2344d122ccadd815be7cbefdb7ca738cf9544f7.jpg[/img]

[h1]EVISCERATE ENEMY LINES WITH BRUTAL ACTS OF VIOLENCE[/h1]
The Night Lords do not perform clean kills. Their sadistic souls seek to punish their prey with physical and psychological methods before making an example out of any poor soul that stands in their way. Their new Murder trait befits these blood-soaked killers, triggering an effect after defeating an enemy if the damage they dealt in the killing blow is superior to the poor victim’s remaining health.

Unlike Battle Honour, Murder will still trigger even if the troop with Murder dies while attacking. Murder is also not troop-exclusive and can be found on Tactics. Plan your attacks carefully and exploit their new mechanic to get as much value as possible out of your troops!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/b2594882afdae3f9b28ad325448b85b754975b7f.jpg[/img]

[h1]CHECK OUT THE FULL CARD GALLERY[/h1]
Visit the website’s [url=https://www.horusheresylegions.com/card-list-hidden-dagger-expansion/nggallery/hidden-dagger/night-lords]Card Collection[/url] to check the complete collection of incoming cards! From the new Warlords to the new tactics and troops. Take a peek at the full extent of the new Night Lords collection so you know how to master the darkness when the Legion’s release comes tomorrow. Check out the new cards and share your ideas in the #deck-building channel of the [url=https://discord.com/invite/horusheresylegions]official Discord server[/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/241252305e4bd191f5135dcd5e2339ba8fe20a5c.jpg[/img]

[h1]A BLACK FRIDAY SPECIAL[/h1]
Get more bang for your buck with the Black Friday special offers and gather the new Night Lords under your banner faster than ever! Find new gold offers with added value, perfect for all the upcoming content in the new expansion.

To celebrate their release, claim an exclusive Night Lords avatar for free! Log into the game during the Black Friday season to receive your reward and imbue your in-game profile with the murderous soul of the VIII Legion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/fc5f22b70e90eef4b62a574debad26682eadeeff.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Agents of the Sigillite fight in the Silent War
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1a405b3bbd7156128ee751f3de2248d0c2f7eab7.jpg[/img]
[i]"The hour is upon us."[/i]
– Malcador the Sigillite

During the Horus Heresy, countless battles matched massive regiments and Legions against one another, yet not many of them could match the ramifications of the secret small-scale operations taken by Malcador and his agents. Take control of the Agents of the Sigillite and enter the realm of secrecy!

[h3]New faction: Agents of the Sigillite[/h3]
While the Emperor was busy with His secret project in the vaults beneath the Imperial Palace, Malcador was named Regent of Terra and took up many major responsibilities in the capital world of the Imperium. Seeing menaces and dangers where no one else dared to look, Malcador started to work on many secret projects too. Among these classified projects, the founding of the Officio Assassinorum and the creation of the Knights-Errant proved to be of great importance after the start of the Horus Heresy. The forces that the Sigillite mustered were able to venture deep behind enemy lines and take part in secret missions that were capable of turning the tides of the entire civil war. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1a405b3bbd7156128ee751f3de2248d0c2f7eab7.jpg[/img]

[h3]Agents of the Sigillite warlords[/h3]
Three collectable Warlords lead the secret forces of the Regent as they fight to protect the Imperium:
[list]
[*]Malcador: A powerful psyker who served as the Regent of Terra and the Emperor's most trusted confidante.
[*]Tylos Rubio: Former Codicier of the Ultramarines, a powerful psyker who become one of the first Knights-Errant recruited by Malcador.
[*]Iota: Assassin of Clade Culexus who was tasked to assassinate Horus in the first ever Execution Force.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/7761e92cb487e51e7b5a46852c125f0bee24d971.jpg[/img]

[h3]How to get Agents of the Sigillite cards[/h3]
You can collect Agents of the Sigillite cards in several ways:
[list]
[*]Each reward crate in the 'The Buried Dagger' event has at least 1 Agents of the Sigillite card.
[*]Agents of the Sigillite crates in the shop have at least 3 Agents of the Sigillite cards, 1 of them rare of better.
[*]A constructed deck in the shop, with Iota as warlord and an exclusive card back. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
[*]Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
[*]VIP subscribers will find 1 guaranteed Agents of the Sigillite card in their Daily Mission crate during the 'The Buried Dagger' event.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1a4823e6733bab91d8238228d1215acb9f3a667a.jpg[/img]

[h3]New event: 'The Buried Dagger'[/h3]
Mysterious happenings have been reported near Terra's White Mountain. After knowing of the area's multiple disappearances and strange gathering, Malcador takes matters into his own hands and leads an investigation. Unfortunately, after Malcador's arrival with his agents, a plot seems to start to unravel! The followers of Chaos clash against the Agents of the Sigillite during their first mission! Join the event and test the Agents of the Sigillite against the forces of Chaos! Keep your eyes open, and watch your back.

[b]The Agents of the Sigillite are now live. Muster the secret forces of the Imperium and play your role in the Hidden War to defend it![/b]

notes.title: The Sisters of Silence scour the battlefield
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/8973e82a163efdc19d1b9334dc1c49903782b281.jpg[/img]
[i]"Only in silence, one can hear the Truth."[/i]
– Jenetia Krole, Knight-Commander

The Sisters of Silence confront the Immaterium and the invisible forces that conspire against the Imperium as they join the game in the Siege of Terra expansion. Lead the Silent Sisterhood and hunt the witch for the Imperium!

[h1]New faction: Sisters of Silence[/h1]
Hard to perceive, clad in Vratine, fast and skilled warriors, the Sisters of Silence have always been fearful opponents whenever they arrive to the battlefield. Their unique status as blanks makes them essentially impervious to the powers of the Warp, and that transforms them into the greatest psyker hunters in the Imperium. Their presence in Prospero's Censure Host was no coincidence, and it will be key once again in Terra if the loyalists expect to defeat the traitor's onslaught.

[h1]Sisters of Silence warlords[/h1]
Three collectable Warlords lead the Silent Sisterhood as they prepare to hunt the witch:
[list]
[*]Amendera Kendel: An unparalleled psyker hunter who went on to become Malcador's Agentia Tertius.
[*]Varonika Sulath: High ranking member of the Sisterhood. She oversaw the implementation of the Unspoken Sanction.
[*]Jenetia Krole: Great leader of the Silent Sisterhood, who became one of the Emperor's personal battle confidantes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/fab994a8bbe7bccff3ef8332af028989d76c4bd9.jpg[/img]

[h1]How to get Sisters of Silence cards[/h1]
You can collect Sisters of Silence cards in several ways:
[list]
[*]Each reward crate in the 'Battle of Somnus Citadel' event has at least 1 Sisters of Silence card.
[*]Sisters of Silence crates in the shop have at least 3 Sisters of Silence cards, 1 of them rare of better.
[*]A constructed deck in the shop, with Amendera Kendel as warlord and an exclusive card back. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
[*]Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
[*]VIP subscribers will find 1 guaranteed Sisters of Silence card in their Daily Mission crate during the 'Battle of Somnus Citadel' event.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1783248a82934c979b0d35ed5e4d72e0977a7c86.jpg[/img]

[h1]New event: 'Battle of Somnus Citadel'[/h1]
The first event of the Sisters of Silence tests them against the forces of Chaos that invaded the Somnus Citadel. At the start of the Heresy, the Sisters of Silence took in refugees from the Death Guard in the Somnus Citadel, their headquarters on Luna. Unfortunately Solun Decius, one of these survivors, gave in to Nurgle and started a warp infestation inside the citadel. Which side will you fight for in this battle? Will you aid the Sisters of Silence or the daemonic forces of Nurgle?

The Sisters of Silence are now live. Take control of the Silent Sisterhood and scour the battlefield!

notes.title: New major expansion announced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/bc8c5ced2e327c27b2ff281088a5868600bcbe56.jpg[/img]

[i]"We will never fall."[/i]
– Sanguinius, Primarch of the Blood Angels

666666666.M31
Following direct orders from the Warmaster, the [b]Blood Angels[/b] venture into the Signus System. Unbeknownst to them, the [b]Daemons of the Ruinstorm[/b] have long taken over the system, laying a trap that will test the IXth Legion to the limit.

Meanwhile, the [b]White Scars[/b] are dispatched to Chondax, where the Warmaster will rely on different means to keep them isolated from the unfolding Heresy.

Three new factions are joining the game! The Blood Angels will join the game first, on 27th March. The hosts of daemons of the Ruinstorm will follow them, on 10th April. Finally, the White Scars will ride into battle on 24th April.

With 140 new cards, 9 Warlords and new cosmetics, this expansion brings exciting new mechanics and will take the game beyond 1000 collectible cards!

As the fires of war grow fiercer, which side will you fight for?

Find out more on the official website!
https://www.horusheresylegions.com/new-expansion-malevolence/

[i]"It is my duty to pass on what I've learned to others."[/i]
– Sanakht

Update v1.4.4 is out with some major improvements to how decks can be shared! You can now share them in the Lodge and Global chats, or copy them to your clipboard and share them anywhere, in a readable text format that can be automatically imported by other players.

How to share a deck:
1) In Cards, click the eye icon next to the deck's name to open the full-deck view.
2) The 'share' button on the top right corner offers three options: share to Lodge, to Global chat, or to clipboard.
3) Once copied to clipboard, you can paste the deck in a readable text format anywhere you like.
4) To import a deck, go to Cards -> Change deck, click on the notepad icon and paste the text.
5) You need to own the warlord to import a deck. Any cards not owned will be highlighted and need to be replaced.

Will you share your battle wisdom, or keep the secret to yourself?
